HINAMORIMOD-KIDO_FUNDAMENTALS.title: Kido Fundamentals
HINAMORIMOD-KIDO_FUNDAMENTALS.descriptio: At the start of combat, gain {Chant} [gold]Chant[/gold].
HINAMORIMOD-KIDO_FUNDAMENTALS.flavor: The first step toward mastering Kido. Daily practice builds lasting strength.
HINAMORIMOD-KIDO_ESSENCE.title: Essence of Kido
HINAMORIMOD-KIDO_ESSENCE.description:
At the start of combat, gain {Chant} [gold]Chant[/gold].
At the start of each turn after the first, gain 1 [gold]Chant[/gold].
HINAMORIMOD-KIDO_ESSENCE.flavor: Years of training reveal the essence of Kido.
HINAMORIMOD-TOBIUME_GUARD.title: Tobiume's Guard
HINAMORIMOD-TOBIUME_GUARD.description: At the start of combat, gain 10 [gold]Ember[/gold].
HINAMORIMOD-TOBIUME_GUARD.flavor: A sword guard carrying the resolve to fight alongside Tobiume.
HINAMORIMOD-FLAME_TALISMAN.title: Flame Talisman
HINAMORIMOD-FLAME_TALISMAN.description: At the start of combat, apply 4 [gold]Burn[/gold] to ALL enemies.
HINAMORIMOD-FLAME_TALISMAN.flavor: A talisman containing the flames of Kido.
HINAMORIMOD-TOBIUME_EMBER.title: Tobiume's Ember
HINAMORIMOD-TOBIUME_EMBER.description: At the end of each turn, gain 1 [gold]Ember[/gold].
HINAMORIMOD-TOBIUME_EMBER.flavor: A small flame continues to burn.
HINAMORIMOD-LAST_EMBER_FRAGMENT.title: Last Ember Fragment
HINAMORIMOD-LAST_EMBER_FRAGMENT.descript: Whenever you apply Burn, increase the amount by 1.
HINAMORIMOD-LAST_EMBER_FRAGMENT.flavor: An item supporting Hinamori's fighting style.
HINAMORIMOD-KIDO_TALISMAN.title: Kido Talisman
HINAMORIMOD-KIDO_TALISMAN.description: Whenever you spend a total of 10 Chant, gain 10 Block.
HINAMORIMOD-KIDO_TALISMAN.flavor: An item supporting Hinamori's fighting style.
HINAMORIMOD-KIDO_PRIMER.title: Kido Primer
HINAMORIMOD-KIDO_PRIMER.description: At the start of combat, choose 1 of 3 random Hinamori cards to add to your hand, then choose a card to discard.
HINAMORIMOD-KIDO_PRIMER.flavor: An item supporting Hinamori's fighting style.
HINAMORIMOD-BURN_CURSE_MARK.title: Burn Curse Mark
HINAMORIMOD-BURN_CURSE_MARK.description: Take 20% less attack damage from enemies with Burn.
HINAMORIMOD-BURN_CURSE_MARK.flavor: An item supporting Hinamori's fighting style.
HINAMORIMOD-KIDO_SECRET_MANUAL.title: Kido Secret Manual
HINAMORIMOD-KIDO_SECRET_MANUAL.descripti: The first Hado or Bakudo you play each turn costs 0 Chant.
HINAMORIMOD-KIDO_SECRET_MANUAL.flavor: An item supporting Hinamori's fighting style.
HINAMORIMOD-FORBIDDEN_ARTS_PRICE.title: Price of Forbidden Arts
HINAMORIMOD-FORBIDDEN_ARTS_PRICE.descrip: At the start of each turn, gain 1 Energy and add a random Status card to your hand.
HINAMORIMOD-FORBIDDEN_ARTS_PRICE.flavor: An item supporting Hinamori's fighting style.
At the start of each Act, after choosing an Ancient relic, gain 1 additional random relic from the same Ancient, excluding relics you already own.
The insignia of the Squad 5 lieutenant.
